reason: Both are commercial-stage branded prescription biopharma companies. Akebia focuses on kidney disease drugs. BioMarin focuses on rare genetic diseases, such as achondroplasia, hemophilia A and lysosomal storage diseases. The therapeutic areas and treating specialists differ, with nephrology and dialysis providers on one side and rare-disease centers on the other. The overlap is the business model and generic channels, such as specialty pharmacies and wholesalers. Both also earn licensing or royalty revenue.
